name: manual_0221a5
claim: Record a peer agent's unreproduced test claims as unreproduced and verify independently before relying on them.

decisions.notes: A peer reported 274 passing tests across five branches that were never reproduced; independent reruns found real review defects in every round.

rationale: A peer reported 274 passing tests across five branches that were never reproduced; independent reruns found real review defects in every round.
